page.layout: One page of text, one main column; a narrow strip of cropped text at the right edge belonging to the neighbouring page (not transcribed as text); no notes in the margins of this page.

main_text.l: multos alios modos quibus Diabolus in
hominum animos illabi poffit, ut il-
los fibi deditos & obftrictos variis modis
ab ipfo illaqueati quafi fint, & proclives
redditi ut ad alia pejora transeant.
Quippe haec gradus sunt, quibus ad va-
certa, at maxime vanis praejudiciis ex in-
vires in haec inferiora agere nullus ne-
get; & signa quaedam in manu, facie &
toto corpore possint esse, sanitatis vel
morbi, quia ejus effecta sunt; & in mine-
ralibus infinita lateant, quae inde deduci

page.notes: The first letter P is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Offemus". The right edge shows partial text of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "pof", "mir", "nor"), which is not transcribed. Some words in the text are set with long s printed as s; the printed "filum" and "prioris" are as printed. Possible printing errors: "Quippe hac gradus" appears as "haec"; "fuper-ftitione" printed with hyphen across lines; "transfeant" read as "transeant".
